Hi Carla — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the milestone doc — that helps a lot.

Short answers:
- The token estimate you shared is within the realm we typically approve for a pilot, provided the milestones and evaluation plan line up.
- We can often grant a short trial extension while legal/PO are in flight, but we do it conditionally (milestone-based credits and KYC).

To move quickly, can you:
1) Confirm company HQ and billing entity name (for our finance/PO process).
2) Upload a brief estimate of concurrent throughput (qps) or expected peak requests so we can size the Dedicated pool if needed.
3) Share any IP/data handling constraints (PII, healthcare data, etc.).

I'll loop in Marissa (Growth) and Rishi (Enterprise sales) to help with the credits and finance path. I also attached our internal credit_request_form.pdf to speed approvals.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Thu 29 Apr 11:00am PT or Fri 30 Apr 9:00am PT — which works for your team?

Hi Carla — thanks for the details and the call request. 

We reviewed the milestones and your token estimate with Product. We're comfortable provisioning a conditional pilot credit allocation subject to:
1) Signed minimal MPA (attached draft: mpa_draft.docx)
2) KYC/PO or signed SOW within 14 days of kickoff; if PO is delayed beyond that we can still open the account but credits are released on milestone delivery.
3) A soft cap of 25M tokens for the initial period; if you need more we can provision incremental credits after review.

Credit schedule (proposed):
- 40% of requested credits at kickoff (account activation)
- 30% after completion of milestone 2 (integration & baseline quality check)
- 30% after demo to internal stakeholder (milestone 4)

If that works, we'll send a DocuSign for the MPA and set a provisional credit hold internally. We can also provide a 2-week trial extension while legal processes the MPA — that extension is conditional on receiving the KYC packet within 7 days.

Proposed call: Thu 29 Apr 11:00am PT (Soojin already suggested) — we'll take that slot and invite Solutions to join for technical sizing.

Best,
